title: Himalayan & Coastal High-Adrenaline Sports
description: White-water rafting in Rishikesh, paragliding in Solang Valley, scuba diving off Havelock Island, and skiing in Gulmarg.

title: Sacred Pilgrimages & River Aarti Rituals
description: Evening Ganga Aarti in Varanasi & Rishikesh, Golden Temple Amritsar, Meenakshi Temple Madurai, and Spiti cliff monasteries.

title: UNESCO Monuments, Forts & Royal Palaces
description: Rajasthan desert hillforts, Taj Mahal Agra, Hampi boulder ruins, Chola temples of Tanjore, and Khajuraho sculptures.

title: Tiger Safaris, One-Horned Rhinos & Marine Sanctuaries
description: Bengal Tiger tracking in Corbett & Bandhavgarh, one-horned rhino safaris in Kaziranga, and Gir Asiatic lions.

title: Regional Culinary Trails & Street Food Safaris
description: Chettinad spicy curries, Lucknowi Awadhi biryanis, Rajasthani Dal Baati, Goan seafood shacks, and Bengali sweets.

title: Misty Hill Estates, Backwaters & Living Root Bridges
description: Kerala houseboat backwaters, Munnar & Coorg tea estates, Living Root Bridges of Meghalaya, and Valley of Flowers.
